item.title: When is NVLink worth it?
item.description:
📝 Nvidia doesn’t support NVLink on consumer GPUs anymore. The Tests I ran a few tests to measure the effect that adding NVLink would have on AI-related workloads: Model Inference with layer split and tensor parallelism. For model inference with tensor parallelism, NVLink boosted prompt processing by about 30%, while token generation speed was exactly the same.
🔗 Read more: https://platform-fools.com/posts/2026-04-27-nvlink/
